mapper.sql:
WHERE t.is_batch=1 AND t.batch_kind <> 'UNCLASSIFIED' AND (t.batch_expires_at IS NULL OR t.batch_expires_at > #{now})
AND COALESCE(t.batch_status,t.status) IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','PAUSED','CANCELLING','AWAITING_CONFIRMATION') AND COALESCE(t.batch_status,t.status) NOT IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','PAUSED','CANCELLING','AWAITING_CONFIRMATION')
AND t.type=#{type} AND COALESCE(t.batch_status,t.status)=#{status} AND (LOWER(t.name) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(t.subject_name) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(t.id) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(t.business_id) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM background_task_relation r JOIN background_task c ON c.id=r.task_id WHERE r.batch_id=t.id AND (LOWER(c.name) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(c.subject_name) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(c.id) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(c.business_id) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM background_task_item i WHERE i.task_id=t.id AND (LOWER(i.title) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(i.id) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM background_scan_scope scope JOIN media_song s ON s.id=scope.song_id WHERE scope.batch_id=t.id AND (LOWER(scope.song_id) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(JSON_EXTRACT(s.result_json,'$.title')) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!')))

CASE WHEN t.type='LX_DOWNLOAD' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lx_download_batch b WHERE b.id=t.business_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN t.song_id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM media_song s WHERE s.id=t.song_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN t.source_id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM media_source s WHERE s.id=t.source_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN t.type='AUDIO_BATCH' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM audio_batch b WHERE b.id=t.business_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN t.type='METADATA' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM metadata_batch b WHERE b.id=t.business_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN t.type='CLASSIFICATION' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM classification_task b WHERE b.id=t.business_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN t.type='CACHE_CLEANUP' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM song_cache_cleanup_job b WHERE b.id=t.business_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 1 END AS subject_available
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, FROM background_task t ORDER BY ,t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT t.*, FROM background_task t WHERE t.id=#{id}

SELECT * FROM background_task_item ORDER BY CASE WHEN status IN ('PROBING','PROCESSING') AND execution_json LIKE '%"jobState":"RUNNING"%' THEN 0 WHEN status IN ('PROBING','PROCESSING') AND execution_json LIKE '%"jobState":"QUEUED"%' THEN 2 WHEN status IN ('RUNNING','PROBING','PROCESSING') THEN 0 WHEN status='CANCELLING' THEN 1 WHEN status IN ('PENDING','QUEUED') THEN 2 WHEN status='PAUSED' THEN 3 ELSE 5 END,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT status,COUNT(*) AS amount FROM background_task_item WHERE task_id=#{taskId} GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT * FROM background_task_item WHERE task_id=#{task_id} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id,type,business_id FROM background_task WHERE id > #{cursor} AND batch_kind='OPERATION' AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','PAUSED','CANCELLING','AWAITING_CONFIRMATION') ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
mapper.sql: AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM background_task_relation r JOIN background_task b ON b.id=r.batch_id WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND (b.batch_expires_at IS NULL OR b.batch_expires_at > #{now}))
mapper.select: SELECT t.id FROM background_task t WHERE <= #{now} ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE background_task SET updated_at=updated_at WHERE id=#{id}
